title: Pipeline Error Transformation
goal: Order iterator and result transformation calls to parse strings and accumulate results.
hints: Start by creating an iterator over the input slices.
Map each slice using parse, then collect or sum into a single Result.
explanation: First, `.iter()` produces an iterator over string slices. Next, `.map()` converts each slice into a `Result<i32, ParseIntError>`. Finally, `.sum()` accumulates the iterator into a single `Result<i32, ParseIntError>`, short-circuiting on the first error encountered.
